statute_note: Principal source: LankaLaw's consolidated PDF data/legal-sources/library/statutes/19-1935-land-development-ordinance.pdf (48 pp, text layer; registry preferred_source_url), parsed with parse_consolidated_pdf.py; the accepted tree was byte-identical to the canonical parse before this pass's hand edits. Other sources inspected: the LankaLaw HTML edition (chain to 20 of 1996, no banner) as verification source; title pages of the eight Government Printer scans held (49/1953, 16/1969, 21/1971, 27/1981, 10/1983, 22/1993, 9/1995, 20/1996) and of the Administrative Districts Act 22 of 1955; LankaLaw HTML of the six Land Development amendment Acts, of the Metric Units Act, and of Laws 43 of 1973 and 13 of 1975; the Government Printer PDF of Act 11 of 2022 in full. Consolidation cutoff: Act No. 11 of 2022 (PDF chain header and markers). Review performed: earlier 5-lens subagent review, 2 rounds, converged; this pass checked every one of the 44 numbering gaps against the PDF text: 27 rest on a printed repeal marker (26; 32-34, 36; 44-45; 50; 69-71; 77-83; 124; 144-151; 171), s.38 on the print's own 'Section 38 is repealed by Act No. 4, 27 of 1981' note, and 88-103 are absent from the PDF without any note but are marked repealed in the HTML edition and by Act 16 of 1969 s.52. All 44 plus 19A, 23A and the First and Second Schedules are listed in omitted_provisions with the marker each rests on. Changes made: the s.38 repeal-note stub, which the parse had turned into a section, was removed (tree now 143 sections; node kept under provenance.removed_node_38); 18 nodes had bracketed repeal footnotes lifted out of text into footnotes_removed_from_text, raw_text unchanged. Amendment coverage: 13 reconciliation rows; 12 instruments already incorporated; Law 13 of 1975 ambiguous (marker present, held copy shows no operation); nothing applied. The canonical-amendments trees 43-1973.json and 13-1975.json are whole principal Laws and are held as omnibus files, not packaged as amendment trees. Structural weaknesses: first_list_item_not_split (documented parser limitation) leaves the first list item fused into the lead-in text in ss.9, 16, 19, 23, 159B and others; 45 sections keep full text beside their first child; the tree has no Chapter nodes although the print has them; the Third and Fourth Schedules and 'the Schedule' are referenced but not extracted; s.23A is printed although a footnote says Law 43 of 1973 repealed it. Missing sources: Ordinance 3 of 1946; no Government Printer copy of the principal text; the operative section of Law 13 of 1975 that the marker cites. Unresolved: the status of s.23A; what '[89, 13 of 1975]' refers to; whether ss.8-24 as printed are the 1981 re-enactment. Registry: title 'Land Development Ordinance' agrees with s.1; head date '[15th October, 1935]' agrees with the tree's commencement; curriculum lists 27/1981, 22/1993 and 9/1995, all reconciled. Index reports 145 sections against the tree's 143 (the removed stub and one legacy heading; not reconciled here). Lawyer verification: unverified. Pipeline status needs_structural_review because of the documented list-splitting defect, the un-extracted Schedules, and the s.23A / 13 of 1975 questions.

source_conflicts: PDF chain header ends 11 of 2022; HTML header ends 20 of 1996 and lacks ss.104A-104D and the 2022 substitutions. PDF used.
PDF prints no marker for the absence of ss.88-103; the HTML prints '[Sections 88 to 103 are repealed by Act No. 16 of 1969]' and Act 16 of 1969 s.52 confirms it.
PDF long title reads 'STATELAND' where the HTML reads 'STATE LAND'; tree keeps the PDF's reading.
PDF footnotes say Chapters II and III (ss.8-24) and ss.19A, 23A were repealed by Law No. 43 of 1973, yet ss.8-24 and 23A are printed; the tree keeps them and records the footnotes in editorial_notes.
